intro: I build worlds for AI agents to live, play and fail in, then measure what they learn: RL environments, world-model simulations and multi-agent games.

projects.name: Kokopelli
projects.tag: an agent living inside a world model
projects.hook: An open-weight LLM agent living a generated life inside a world model I built: an Unreal city, painted into real-looking video by Cosmos, seen and acted on by Qwen. Runs on one laptop, with a 5-arm study on whether lived experience changes a model.

projects.name: Talisman
projects.hook: AI teammates in bughouse chess deciding whether to think, talk or move, all on one clock. I fixed the engine's macOS search bug (24 → 657 nodes in 3 s) and train the scheduler on Georgia Tech's PACE cluster.

projects.name: RSI-RL
projects.hook: A self-improving factory for RL coding tasks: mines real developer complaints, checks them against papers, and holds every task near a 25% frontier pass rate behind a 7-stage test gate.

projects.name: SilverKey
projects.tag: a transaction OS for home sales
projects.hook: The startup I founded and ran for 16 months: a 9-person team shipping web and mobile apps wired into eXp Realty, DocuSign, ATTOM and Plaid, with a ranking model that learns each buyer's taste.

projects.name: Kusama
projects.tag: a medium agents can paint in
projects.hook: A painting medium for RL agents where the same program always renders byte-identical pixels, so art rewards can be replayed and checked. Novelty is scored against 20,000 CLIP-embedded museum works.

projects.name: Concept discovery
projects.hook: A 5.6M-parameter AlphaZero-style chess agent and a pre-registered test of feature-diverse search: 41.5% vs 35.0% of 200 held-out mates at 3,072 simulations.

projects.name: DealRoom
projects.tag: can small models close a deal
projects.hook: A synthetic deal environment for tool-using agents, graded by a deterministic verifier: Qwen3 8B closed 13 of 32 deals, Llama 3.1 8B 1 of 46. Then SFT vs SFT + RL on Llama.

projects.name: Kusama studio
projects.hook: A frozen vision-language model directing a frozen image model, every edit saved with its lineage. Its scale edit touched 1.65% of the image and changed none of the 1,031,297 protected pixels.

projects.name: Shared whiteboard
projects.hook: A real-time multi-user whiteboard built as a timed take-home: transactional versioning so racing edits never tear a shape. 26 of 26 concurrency checks with 5 users, 3 runs in a row.

projects.name: Rent roll reader
projects.tag: scanned PDFs to a comps database
projects.hook: The core of OM-Analyzer, where I was CTO: an OCR pipeline that turns scanned broker rent rolls into a searchable tenant comps database.

projects.name: Injectable PrEP model
projects.hook: A week-by-week microsimulation and cost-effectiveness model of injectable HIV PrEP for people experiencing homelessness. Its sharpest finding: outreach without the injection is the most cost-effective arm.

projects.name: reels-edits
projects.hook: A dashboard that cuts images to the beat as a seamless loop. In the demo every cut landed within 16 ms of the beat.

education: **Georgia Institute of Technology**, B.S. Computer Science, specialization in Artificial Intelligence. GPA 3.61. Graduating December 2026.
skills: PyTorch, RL, MCTS, RL environments and evals
quality-diversity search, LoRA, CLIP, LLM and VLM pipelines
PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Slurm and HPC
